spans.s: गड् vt. 1P (pp. गडित) To distill, to draw.
गड m. 1. A screen; 2. a fence; 3. a ditch, a moat; 4. an impediment; 5. a kind of fish.
गड-उत्थ, -देशज, -लवण n. rock or fossil salt, especially that found in the district called Gaḍa.

गडु (I) a. Crooked, hump-backed.
गडु (II) m. 1. A hump on the back; 2. a javelin; 3. a water-pot; 4. any useless or good-for-nothing object. (Cf. अंतर्गडु).
